Thought: I need to implement the iterative spatial outlier detection method. I'll compute local neighbor averages, then iteratively fit a regression of borough value on local average, removing the most extreme standardized residual each time until convergence, to avoid masking.
Action:
```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = "chunks_csv/outlierr/2022_no2.csv"
ADJACENCY_PATH = "chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv"

df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Build symmetric neighbor map
neighbors = {}
for b in df['borough']:
    neighbors[b] = set()
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b, n = row['borough'], row['neighbor']
    neighbors[b].add(n)
    neighbors[n].add(b)

values = dict(zip(df['borough'], df['NO2_value']))
borough_list = df['borough'].tolist()

# Compute local averages (mean of neighbors)
local_avgs = {}
for b in borough_list:
    nbs = neighbors[b]
    local_avgs[b] = np.mean([values[n] for n in nbs])

# Arrays for regression
X = np.array([local_avgs[b] for b in borough_list])  # local averages
Y = np.array([values[b] for b in borough_list])      # actual values

# Iterative-R style: iteratively remove worst outlier from regression
remaining = set(range(len(borough_list)))
threshold = 3.0  # stop when max |std residual| < 3

print("Starting iterative removal...")
while True:
    idx = list(remaining)
    x = X[idx]
    y = Y[idx]
    
    # OLS fit on remaining points
    n = len(x)
    x_mean = np.mean(x)
    y_mean = np.mean(y)
    b_slope = np.sum((x - x_mean) * (y - y_mean)) / np.sum((x - x_mean)**2)
    a_int = y_mean - b_slope * x_mean
    
    # Predictions for ALL points
    preds = a_int + b_slope * X
    residuals = Y - preds
    
    # Std dev using remaining points only
    mse = np.mean(residuals[idx]**2)
    sigma = np.sqrt(mse)
    std_residuals = residuals / sigma
    
    worst_idx = max(remaining, key=lambda i: abs(std_residuals[i]))
    worst_std = abs(std_residuals[worst_idx])
    
    print(f"  n={n}, worst: {borough_list[worst_idx]}, std_resid={worst_std:.4f}")
    
    if worst_std < threshold:
        break
    remaining.remove(worst_idx)

# Final model parameters
idx = list(remaining)
x = X[idx]
y = Y[idx]
x_mean = np.mean(x)
y_mean = np.mean(y)
b_slope = np.sum((x - x_mean) * (y - y_mean)) / np.sum((x - x_mean)**2)
a_int = y_mean - b_slope * x_mean

preds = a_int + b_slope * X
residuals = Y - preds
mse = np.mean(residuals[idx]**2)
sigma = np.sqrt(mse)
std_residuals = residuals / sigma

print(f"\nFinal model: NO2 = {a_int:.4f} + {b_slope:.4f} * local_avg")
print(f"Sigma (from clean set): {sigma:.4f}")
print(f"Clean set size: {len(remaining)}")

for i in sorted(list(remaining))[:5]:
    print(f"  {borough_list[i]}: actual={Y[i]:.4f}, local_avg={X[i]:.4f}, pred={preds[i]:.4f}, std_resid={std_residuals[i]:.4f}")

hounslow_i = borough_list.index('Hounslow')
print(f"\nHounslow: actual={Y[hounslow_i]:.4f}, local_avg={X[hounslow_i]:.4f}, pred={preds[hounslow_i]:.4f}")
print(f"Hounslow residual: {residuals[hounslow_i]:.4f}")
print(f"Hounslow std residual: {std_residuals[hounslow_i]:.4f}")
```

    neighbors[b].add(n)

values = dict(zip(df['borough'], df['NO2_value']))
borough_list = sorted(df['borough'].tolist())  # sort for consistency

# Compute local averages
local_avgs = {}
for b in borough_list:

# Arrays
X = np.array([local_avgs[b] for b in borough_list])
Y = np.array([values[b] for b in borough_list])

preds = intercept + slope * X

std_resids = residuals / sigma

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = "chunks_csv/outlierr/2022_no2.csv"
ADJACENCY_PATH = "chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv"

df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Build symmetric adjacency
neighbors = {b: set() for b in df['borough']}
for _, r in adj.iterrows():
    neighbors[r['borough']].add(r['neighbor'])
    neighbors[r['neighbor']].add(r['borough'])

values = dict(zip(df['borough'], df['NO2_value']))
boroughs = sorted(df['borough'].tolist())
n_total = len(boroughs)

# Local averages
loc_avg = {b: np.mean([values[nb] for nb in neighbors[b]]) for b in boroughs}

# Arrays
X = np.array([loc_avg[b] for b in boroughs])
Y = np.array([values[b] for b in boroughs])

# Iterative removal
remaining = set(range(n_total))
threshold = 3.0

while True:
    idx = list(remaining)
    x, y = X[idx], Y[idx]
    xm, ym = np.mean(x), np.mean(y)
    slope = np.sum((x - xm) * (y - ym)) / np.sum((x - xm)**2)
    inter = ym - slope * xm
    
    preds = inter + slope * X
    resid = Y - preds
    sigma = np.sqrt(np.sum(resid[idx]**2) / (len(idx) - 2))
    z = resid / sigma
    
    worst = max(remaining, key=lambda i: abs(z[i]))
    if abs(z[worst]) < threshold:
        break
    remaining.remove(worst)

# Final values
idx = list(remaining)
x, y = X[idx], Y[idx]
xm, ym = np.mean(x), np.mean(y)
slope = np.sum((x - xm) * (y - ym)) / np.sum((x - xm)**2)
inter = ym - slope * xm

preds = inter + slope * X
resid = Y - preds
sigma = np.sqrt(np.sum(resid[idx]**2) / (len(idx) - 2))
z_all = resid / sigma

hounslow_i = boroughs.index('Hounslow')
print(f"Hounslow z = {z_all[hounslow_i]:.10f}")
print(f"Removed: {[boroughs[i] for i in range(n_total) if i not in remaining]}")
